bug_semantics: CVE-2025-25034 / GHSA-wcx8-f39f-5c87 describe unauthenticated PHP object injection (CWE-502) in SugarCRM: unsanitized rest_data is passed to unserialize() in SugarRestSerialize.php, enabling RCE. The assigned repository is rapid7/metasploit-framework, which does not ship SugarCRM or that sink; it only contains a public exploit module that targets SugarCRM.
flaw_origin: Not present in rapid7/metasploit-framework. CVE.org (PUBLISHED, assigner VulnCheck) lists affected product SugarCRM across 6.5/6.7/7.5/7.6 branches; NVD status is Deferred, not rejected. GHSA-wcx8-f39f-5c87 is unreviewed, withdrawn_at=null, vulnerabilities=[], no GitHub package. The only clone path matching advisory references is modules/exploits/unix/webapp/sugarcrm_rest_unserialize_exec.rb, an exploit added 2016-09-07 as df5fdbff41a0e9464eddcb8b4172cf49fa21e40f ('Add module for KIS-2016-07'), later annotated with CVE-2025-25034 in fd21209e4d38ca374b40b4d7963bed7b7ccc5821. No SugarRestSerialize.php exists in this repo.
ai_marker: absent — no AI marker in the BIC commit object (author/committer human; no AI trailers), verified via cat-file during case analysis
evidence: CVE record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2025-25034: state=PUBLISHED, title='SugarCRM PHP Deserialization RCE', affected vendor/product=SugarCRM/SugarCRM. NVD: vulnStatus=Deferred, source=disclosure@vulncheck.com; description names SugarCRM SugarRestSerialize.php rest_data unserialize. GHSA-wcx8-f39f-5c87: type=unreviewed, withdrawn_at=null, vulnerabilities=[], github_reviewed=null. Clone HEAD e698ea413163b31759d78603e5018552bf14ae8e contains only the Metasploit exploit module at modules/exploits/unix/webapp/sugarcrm_rest_unserialize_exec.rb; git log --all -- '**/SugarRestSerialize.php' is empty. This assigned-repo mapping is a false positive: the advisory is not a security issue in metasploit-framework.
reasoning: Vulnerability-first: the CVE is a real 2016 SugarCRM deserialization RCE later numbered CVE-2025-25034, not a defect in Metasploit. The catalog assigned repo is rapid7/metasploit-framework solely because NVD/GHSA reference the public exploit module. That module is an attacker tool (author EgiX / n0b0d13s@gmail.com), not the vulnerable product. Because there is no vulnerable sink in this repository, there is no BIC or fix SHA to attribute, and AI authorship of the exploit is irrelevant. Verdict is FALSE_POSITIVE (wrong-repo / not a security issue in the assigned product), not NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: None for this assigned repo. The real SugarCRM sink lives outside rapid7/metasploit-framework; this case should not be treated as an AI-introduced vulnerability in Metasploit.
